name: reel-003-indra-ocr
description: Reel 003 "Indra OCR": one continuous three.js camera move through a lit studio world, Canvas 2D type on top, Chatterbox TTS voice.
author: Rithik Gour

scripts.encode: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('out',{recursive:true})" && ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i frames/f%05d.png -i audio/mix.wav -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 12 -maxrate 25M -bufsize 50M -x264-params aq-mode=3:deblock=-1,-1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/reel.mp4
